text: Runner on 3rd, less than 2 outs: drive it in the air.
3-1, runner on 2nd: take or look fastball.
Runner on 1st, no outs: move him over.
Two outs, runner on 2nd: drive the gap.
2-0, nobody on: sit fastball and pull it.
Full count, winning run on 3rd: put the ball in play.
Runners on 1st and 3rd, one out: ground ball to the right side.
0-2, runner on 3rd: spoil it up the middle.
Bases loaded, one out: a fly ball scores.
Hit and run, runner going: swing through the middle.
1-1, leadoff inning: look for one you can drive to the pull side.
Two strikes, chase pitch off the plate: take.
Sacrifice fly, runner on 3rd, less than 2 outs.
2-1, pitch is away: drive it the other way.
First pitch of the at-bat, middle-in: let it travel and pull it.
Two strikes, runner on 1st: fight it off up the middle.
